easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.
